summary: Round 3.5 closes the round-3 explicitly_out_of_scope list. Delivered: performance (route-level lazy split, terser + gzip/brotli, vite manualChunks fix, service worker + PWA, HTTP-level headers), international targeting (hreflang en + x-default), search-engine push (IndexNow), CMS drift handling (301s for 9 dead blog slugs), internal mesh (Footer link update + priorityPosts realignment), content honesty (removed unsubstantiated multipliers, honest tech-demo count), and 2 verification bugfixes (vendor circular chunk hazard + TwitterCard title clobber). Lighthouse deltas: FCP -8.3s avg, LCP -13.1s avg, page weight -37% avg. All 5 SEO audits pass on all 68 prerendered routes.

route_lazy_loading.note: 30 route pages moved from static imports to React.lazy() so initial bundle only loads Hero + above-the-fold. Route-level code splitting.

vendor_bundle_fix.note: manualChunks now emits only opt-in buckets (vendor-monaco / vendor-chart / vendor-gql). React, react-dom, framer-motion, react-flow, react-slick, react-syntax-highlighter, helmet-async, react-icons all collapse into a single vendor chunk. Previous separate vendor-react caused a circular-chunk edge — libs that touch React.default.PureComponent at top-level module evaluation exploded with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading PureComponent)' and prerender captured empty <div id=root>.

compression.note: terser (with pure_funcs stripping console.log/debug/info in prod, keep warn/error) + vite-plugin-compression emits .gz and .br sidecars for assets > 10 KB, deleteOriginFile=false so hosts can pick .gz/.br when Accept-Encoding matches.

resource_hints.note: preconnect + dns-prefetch to Hygraph CDN and Google Fonts. theme-color meta. apple-touch-icon.

hero_video.note: Added poster, loading=lazy, fetchPriority=low, aria-label. Trades LCP for perceived load without breaking a11y.

pwa_and_service_worker.manifest: public/manifest.webmanifest — name, short_name, start_url, display=standalone, theme_color, icons.
pwa_and_service_worker.service_worker: public/sw.js — cache-first strategy for static assets, network-first for HTML documents, install/activate lifecycle handlers.
pwa_and_service_worker.index_html_link: index.html links manifest via <link rel=manifest> and registers SW via inline script guarded by 'serviceWorker' in navigator.

hosting_headers.netlify_headers: public/_headers — Cache-Control immutable for /assets/*, no-cache for HTML, security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy).
hosting_headers.netlify_redirects: public/_redirects — 9 x 301 for dead blog slugs pointing to closest live post; SPA fallback last (200 /*.html).
hosting_headers.vercel_json: vercel.json — same 9 x 301 with permanent:true; SPA fallback via routes.
hosting_headers.netlify_toml: netlify.toml — mirrors _redirects for portability across Netlify build environments.

hreflang.note: Emits <link rel=alternate hreflang=en href={canonical} /> plus <link rel=alternate hreflang=x-default href={canonical} />. Correct pattern for a single-language site — disambiguates regional English variants (en-US, en-GB, en-IN) and tells Google to serve this URL to users whose language is not otherwise matched. When additional languages ship, unroll additional alternate tags (react-helmet-async does not accept mapped arrays as Helmet children).

indexnow.note: Submits changed URLs to Bing / Yandex / Seznam via IndexNow API. Reads canonical URL list from sitemap.xml. Configurable via INDEXNOW_KEY env var. To run: `node scripts/indexnow-submit.mjs`.

footer_resources.note: Resources dropdown now includes Blog, Benchmarks, Glossary, Case Studies (previously only 2 links). Adds 4 site-wide inbound links to each of these routes.

priority_posts_realignment.note: priorityPosts array updated to 4 live slugs matching current Hygraph state: dicom-pipeline, geotiffs-to-pixel, video-ml-clip, audio-ml. Previously listed 9 slugs, 5 of which no longer exist in Hygraph (drift). Also updated staticRoutes list.

routes_snapshot.note: 69 paths regenerated from live Hygraph fetch. Prerender reads this synchronously; live Hygraph fetches inside vite.config.js are dangerous because Vite dies on Node network errors.

tech_demo_panel_honesty.note: "Trusted by 40+ enterprise teams" replaced with "Four shipped demos live on Hugging Face" — verifiable claim (dicom-pipeline, geotiffs-to-pixel, video-ml-clip, audio-ml all live on HF Spaces).

removed_multipliers.note: serviceContent array reduced to [] with explanatory comment. Previous content contained unsubstantiated 100x/1000x/150x multipliers with no citation, which fail an honesty audit and would fail a customer proof request.

cms_drift_301s.note: Between round 3 sitemap generation and round 3.5, 9 blog slugs were removed from Hygraph. Rather than serve 404s (which drop internal PageRank), we 301 each to the closest live post.

seo_in_all_render_branches.note: Previously <SEO/> was only rendered inside the loaded branch. If Hygraph took longer than the prerender's helmet-wait window (15s), the snapshot captured a loading skeleton with NO title/description/canonical. Now <SEO/> renders on every branch (loading, not-found, loaded) so the snapshot always has a valid <title>/<meta description>/canonical.

slug_derived_fallback.note: titleFromSlug() function converts a slug into a titlecased human-readable title. Used when Hygraph fetch is pending or the slug is not yet resolved — e.g., 'audio-ml' becomes 'Audio Ml'. The suffix '| Jedi Labs Research' is always appended.

clamp_title_helper.note: clampTitle(raw) enforces the audit-title-length 70-char FAIL ceiling. Logic: if raw + ' | Jedi Labs Research' <= 60, use it; else if raw <= 65, use raw alone; else word-boundary-truncate raw at position <= 62 and append ellipsis. Prevents CMS titles > 70 chars (like audio-ml's 89-char raw title) from failing the audit.

twitter_card_de_conflict.note: CRITICAL FIX: previously TwitterCard emitted its own <title>, <meta name=description>, and <link rel=canonical> via <Helmet>. Because TwitterCard mounts inside PostDetail (after Hygraph resolves), react-helmet-async treated it as a later writer and clobbered BlogPage's already-set title/description/canonical. This stripped the '| Jedi Labs Research' brand suffix from every blog post title and pushed audio-ml past the 70-char FAIL cap. Now TwitterCard emits ONLY og:image / Twitter card meta / article:published_time — the SEO tags in BlogPage are the single source of truth. DO NOT RE-ADD title/description/canonical to TwitterCard.

prerender_blog_wait.note: Route-specific waitForFunction (10s timeout, 200ms polling) for /blog/post/*. Waits for either <h1 class=text-3xl> (rendered by PostDetail after Hygraph resolves) OR <meta property=og:image> with a hygraph.com/media.graphassets.com URL (emitted by TwitterCard). See KNOWN LIMITATIONS for the remaining race.

lighthouse_mobile_simulated_single_run.environment: Chrome 148, Lighthouse 12, Moto G Power throttling, 4x CPU slowdown, 1.6Mbps down, single run per route
lighthouse_mobile_simulated_single_run.interpretation: Weight, FCP, LCP are deterministic wins driven by compression, code splitting, and preload. Perf score dropped because CLS spiked on 5 of 7 routes on this single-run capture (needs 3-run median to distinguish signal from noise). TBT delta of +85ms is within noise band.

assets_removed.note: ~70 MB of unreferenced 3D GLTF/BIN/PNG assets from an earlier design iteration. Grep of src/ shows no references. Still allowed as fetch by robots.txt (specifically excluded from crawler-blocking Disallow rule).

known_limitations.description: Blog post prerender captures either the real CMS title or the slug-derived fallback depending on which resolves first in a given puppeteer session. Every build lands 2-4 of 4 blog posts with real CMS titles; the remaining 0-2 get slug-derived fallback (e.g., 'Dicom Pipeline | Jedi Labs Research' instead of 'From DICOM to Production Classifier: A 5-Epoch Radiograph Pipeline'). The waitForFunction in vite.config.js resolves before the snapshot but react-helmet-async's requestAnimationFrame batch write to document.head does not always finish before puppeteer's page.content() call captures the DOM.
known_limitations.impact: None on audit-pass status — slug-derived titles are still branded, unique, and within 15-70 char range. Impact is cosmetic: the snapshot label is generic instead of the article's real headline.
remediation_options: Accept as-is (recommended) — audits pass, titles are valid, Google will re-crawl and pick up the real title from dynamic hydration.
Bump renderAfterTime from 3000ms to 5000-8000ms (adds ~30-60s per build across 69 routes). Reduces variability but doesn't guarantee elimination.
Post-process /blog/post/*/index.html after prerender using the sitemap-provided title. Requires new script + Hygraph fetch outside the puppeteer step.

known_limitations.description: 5 of 7 Lighthouse-audited routes showed CLS jumps on the round-3.5 single-run capture (glossary 0.007->0.315, industries 0.102->1.000, contact 0->0.308, blog 0.351->0.914). CLS on localhost throttled measurement is notoriously variable.
known_limitations.impact: Cannot trust perf-score delta from a single-run capture. Real-world CDN measurement and 3-run median are needed for a reliable perf-score benchmark.
remediation_options: Re-run Lighthouse with --runs=3 median once site is on CDN.
Investigate /industries and /blog for real layout shift — reserve fixed heights on Hygraph-driven article grid.
Investigate xray-classifier tags missing width/height (baseline CLS 1.0 -> post 1.2, an unrelated pre-existing bug).

known_limitations.description: One blog post (/blog/post/dicom-pipeline) renders more than one <h1>. This is a warn, not a fail, but current SEO best practice is single-h1-per-page.
known_limitations.impact: None on audit-pass; may impact accessibility tree navigation.
remediation_options: In PostDetail.jsx, demote the secondary heading (likely the article's inline title in a hero card) to <h2>.
Or use CSS to visually match h1-styling on the h2.

recommended_next_rounds.focus: Real-world Core Web Vitals — 3-run median Lighthouse on the deployed CDN. Fix CLS layout shifts on /industries and /blog. Fix multi-h1 on dicom-pipeline. Fix xray-classifier image sizing.
Backlink outreach execution — GitHub README updates, HF Space page cross-links, LinkedIn post cadence, guest post pitches. Round 3.5 delivered targets + template; round 4 delivers actual outreach.
Blog post title race elimination — post-process /blog/post/*/index.html using sitemap-provided titles OR migrate blog to a server-rendered route that queries Hygraph before response.
